description: PRUG del Carrascar de la Font Roja - Telecomunicaciones is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icvficherosweb.icv.gva.es. Telecommunications areas included in the Master Plan for Use and Management (PRUG) of the Carrascar de la Font Roja Natural Park. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "PRUG del Carrascar de la Font Roja - Telecommunications" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Espacios protegidos, Medio ambiente, ANEXO III, ICV_CLAS:Medi ambient;Espais Protegits. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
